expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Coast and island rather than cities. For a honeymoon with five nights, this is the version with the least packing and unpacking.
expert.tip: The Phu Quoc cable car is the longest over water anywhere. Take the first car of the day and you will have it almost to yourselves.

summary: Six days for two on the coast and an island: three nights in Da Nang with a basket boat ride at Cam Thanh, Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge and a free day, then two on Phu Quoc with Grand World, the cable car over the sea and the Aquatopia water park.
included: Included: 5 nights with breakfast and dinner daily; the domestic flight to Phu Quoc; private transfers throughout; a half day Cam Thanh basket boat trip; a full day up at Ba Na with the Golden Bridge; the Grand World tour; a full day island tour with the cable car and the Aquatopia water park.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
